a: Preview ghost paints hidden nodes and nodes on hidden layers while their container is dragged
Departure ghost paints a removed `hidden` node (and its subtree)
Worker decides "page builds the scene" from the raw `layers.scene` prop, not the slot after presets
A runtime change to `viewport.pan`/`zoom`/`touchZoom` re-registers the action over the `actions` prop's merge, which is not re-applied
Content bounds are cached on `scene.getVersion()`, which pose overrides and scroll offsets do not bump
`colorAt` samples scene layers `layerOrder` leaves out, and in the slot's order rather than the painted one
`useBakedScene` hands a later `SerializedScene` prop through as if it were a live `Scene`
b: Preview ghost paints descendants the scene does not draw: hidden nodes and nodes on hidden layers
Preview and departure ghosts paint at the world pose, ignoring the scene slot's `drawnPose` (the quantize rule's drawn half)
Departure ghost fades out nodes the scene never painted: `hidden` nodes and hidden members of a removed group
The `actions` prop never reaches tool- and contribution-owned actions: they register after its resolver runs
The `colorAt` dep ignores `layerOrder`: it samples scene layers the canvas does not draw, stacked in the wrong order
Hover is only tracked when the `chromeVisibility` prop or `onHoverChange` is given, so `hovering` rules set any other way never match
`useBakedScene` hands a later `SerializedScene` prop through as a live `Scene`
